newsitem.title: USA: Contifinancial acquires auto finance stake.
newsitem.headline: Contifinancial acquires auto finance stake.

text.p: ContiFinancial Corp said Friday it acquired 53.5 percent of Triad Financial Corp's common for undisclosed terms.
ContiFinancial said it will eventually acquire all of the stock of Triad, a privately held auto finance company headquartered in Huntington Beach, Calif.
Triad, with 105 employees, originates non-prime auto finance contracts for used and new vehicles.
"Triad represents a further diversification for ContiFinancial to include a subsidiary involved with a product other than home equity loans," the company said.
ContiFinancial has acted as an investment banker to several sub-prime and non-prime auto companies over the past few years, it noted.
